# GetGlobex

> GetGlobex (getglobex.com) is an AI supplier-matching marketplace. We are not a broker, and we don't offer forex, CFD or investment products. It matches US importers with suppliers worldwide: bring your HS code, get a ranked shortlist of suppliers already shipping on US import lanes, then a free matched intro. Priority seed origins are Vietnam, India and Mexico. GetGlobex is not a trading company or a product catalog, and it does not take title to goods.

Key facts (from the site):

- Paths: buyers request a free match; exporters create a free seller profile (join); both are matched on US-lane shipment signals, not storefront claims.
- Pricing: match requests and matched intros are free while the marketplace densifies; a commission comes later only if density and closed trades justify it.
- Any HS code can be submitted. Furniture (HS 94) and plastics (HS 39) pages are example lane context only.
- Status: the site is live, but the match request, seller profile and contact forms are non-collecting previews. Nothing is stored or sent yet.
- GetGlobex publishes no ratings, testimonials, certifications, ESG scores, supplier counts, GMV or turnaround SLAs.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://getglobex.com/): AI matching for US importers and suppliers worldwide: overview, priority origins and how matching works.
- [For buyers](https://getglobex.com/buyers.html): Customs-proven shortlists for US importers, with free intros while the marketplace densifies.
- [For sellers](https://getglobex.com/sellers.html): Free seller profile and AI matching to US importers in your HS.
- [How it works](https://getglobex.com/how-it-works.html): Match path: match request → US-lane shortlist → free matched intro.
- [About](https://getglobex.com/about.html): What GetGlobex is (and isn't), plus the free-first, commission-later model.
- [FAQ](https://getglobex.com/faq.html): Straight answers on free matches, finding your HS, origins, timing and lane-scale numbers.

## Get started

- [Request a free match](https://getglobex.com/rfq.html): Buyer match request by HS code (non-collecting preview form).
- [Create a free seller profile](https://getglobex.com/sellers/join.html): Seller join by HS, origin and US-lane proof (non-collecting preview form).
- [Contact](https://getglobex.com/contact.html): Paths for match requests, applying to sell, or partnership and other questions.
